# `aitbc crosschain swap`

Create a cross-chain token swap via a real signed bridge lock. The wallet signs the swap request; the node locks ``amount`` on the source chain and the bridge releases ``amount * rate`` on the target chain once the lock reaches finality. The reported ``from_tx_hash`` is the real hash of the on-chain BRIDGE_LOCK transaction.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc crosschain swap [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--from-chain` | text | — | yes | Source chain ID |
| `--to-chain` | text | — | yes | Target chain ID |
| `--from-token` | text | — | yes | Source token symbol |
| `--to-token` | text | — | yes | Target token symbol |
| `--amount` | decimal | — | yes | Amount to swap (AIT) |
| `--min-amount` | decimal | — | no | Minimum amount to receive on target chain (AIT) |
| `--slippage` | float | `0.01` | no | Slippage tolerance (0-0.1) |
| `--recipient` | text | — | no | Recipient address on the target chain (defaults to the sender) |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet name or file path for signing |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL (source-chain producer) |
| `--wait` | flag | `false` | no | Poll status until the transfer reaches a terminal state |
| `--timeout` | integer | `300` | no | Seconds to wait with --wait (default 300) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc crosschain swap --from-chain <from_chain> --to-chain <to_chain> --from-token <from_token> --to-token <to_token> --amount <amount>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc crosschain swap --from-chain <from_chain> --to-chain <to_chain> --from-token <from_token> --to-token <to_token> --amount <amount> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
